title: I purchased Premium, and I have somethings to say...
body: I gotta say, this app is really useful and beautiful. The only thing keeping me from giving it five stars is I find it is lacking some features that I’d really love to have. First off, it’d be a waste if you didn’t support gifs, your app already uses images for motivation, so why no add gifs as a premium feature? Secondly, why not add an option for sounds and music while the users are setting up the habits? Like, every habit can have its own unique music and sounds so the user can get more motivated? That’s all I have for now.
author: Idkwhatevenisthis123
